title: Research (no kappa claim): classical Pappus/Desargues T=3 pairing-cost census — no cost < v falsifier; tight atoms through v = 6
head: ad449e6aa736396c779535dbdea04a402aab03ca
body:
## Result

Scoped negative, no kappa claim. A first answer to **item 4** of the open-ends request
([discussion comment 18932893](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18932893)):
the classical rich configurations **Pappus** and **Desargues**, named there as untested
candidates for tight atoms or counterexamples of the T = 3 core `(Q <= F2)`, were tested in
the exact [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) model. **No `cost < v` instance exists in the tested domain.** New package
`research/classical-t3-config-screen-seed3e11/` only; the selected record, both suppliers,
`upstream/` and all frozen pins are unchanged.

Precise statement: over all admissible pairings `B` (0/1 over F2, unit diagonal, ones only
where `p(t) dot q(s) = 0`), `cost(B) = sum_j rank_F2 B[R_j, A_j]` with
`R_j = {t : p_j(t) != 0}`, `A_j = {s : q_j(s) != 0}`. Of **1,326,413** sub-configurations of
the Pappus (54 valid `(p, q)` pairs) and Desargues (70 pairs) pair sets, each priced **exactly
over all `2^f` admissible B** (f = free incidences, `f <= 20`), **none** has minimum cost below
`v`. Every sub-configuration of size `v <= 4` is exhaustive (1,319,225 instances); sizes 5..10
are fixed-seed samples (seed 20261015). The full pair sets survive a randomized falsifier
search (120 single-bit-descent restarts each).

| Size v | Pappus tested / exact / tight (`cost = v`) | Desargues tested / exact / tight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 54 / 54 / 20 | 70 / 70 / 25 |
| 2 | 1,431 / 1,431 / 198 | 2,415 / 2,415 / 308 |
| 3 | 24,804 / 24,804 / 1,310 | 54,740 / 54,740 / 2,510 |
| 4 | 316,251 / 316,251 / 6,579 | 916,895 / 916,895 / 15,318 |
| 5 | 3,000 / 3,000 / 20 | 3,000 / 3,000 / 15 |
| 6 | 1,500 / 1,500 / 3 | 1,500 / 1,500 / 2 |
| 7 | 300 / 300 / 0 | 300 / 300 / 0 |
| 8 | 60 / 56 / 0 | 60 / 60 / 0 |
| 9 | 20 / 13 / 0 | 20 / 17 / 0 |
| 10 | 10 / 1 / 0 | 10 / 6 / 0 |

"Exact" counts instances with `f <= 20`, fully enumerated; the rest are recorded as
`skipped_f_cap` and were not priced exactly. Two observations: tight atoms are common at
small sizes and disappear in the samples from size 7 on (sampled minima rise strictly above
`v` there), and the full pair sets are far from tight (Pappus `v = 54`: dense 109, identity
104, search best **108** with block ranks 36,36,36; Desargues `v = 70`: dense 145, identity
137, search best **146** with block ranks 49,48,49). So the rich pair sets do not approach the
`cost >= v` boundary at all.

**Nearest overlapping work (surfaced by the pre-submission overlap refresh).**
https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2274 (thakrarsagar; claim
https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18936306)
already treats **the same object** (Desargues 10_3 and Pappus 9_3 as T = 3 decoder atoms,
answering the same open-ends item 4) by a different method: frame-universal char-2 (CR2)
certificates giving `cost >= v` for every configuration of non-incident pairs in a certified
frame, **conditional on Lemma CR2 of the open [PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162)**, plus exact pairing-cost minima only for
the 18 enumerable non-CR2 instances of one special Pappus frame (their min(cost - v) = 1).
This package is an independent, unconditional corroboration by direct exact enumeration of raw
pairing costs over all admissible B: it carries no CR2 or [PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162) premise, prices 1,326,413
instances across both geometries including an exhaustive v <= 4 census and tight-atom counts
that [PR 2274](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2274) does not compute, and adds the full pair-set landscape. [PR 2274](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2274)'s frame-conditional
coverage is far broader in v; the two results are complementary and neither supersedes the
other. The overlap was missed at entry because the pre-computation overlap re-run used the
request's terminology (`char2-jets`, `three-total-decoders`) and not the geometry names
(`Pappus`, `Desargues`); this is recorded as a workflow failure in the session handoff.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14, Windows x64, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/classical-t3-config-screen-seed3e11/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/classical-t3-config-screen-seed3e11 --check-only
```

Measured 470 s for the verifier. Expected and observed marker:

```text
PASS_CLASSICAL_T3_CONFIG_SCREEN controls=18/12 pappus_exact=347410 pappus_tight=8130 desargues_exact=979003 desargues_tight=18178 falsifiers=0 full_best=108/146 no_new_kappa
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

Positive fixtures, from pinned bytes of the [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) head: `data/cex_wholeTS_v9.json` reproduces
its documented exact minimum 18 (block ranks 7,4,7, 16 minimisers) and `data/cex_joint_v7.json`
its documented minimum 12 (block ranks 4,4,4, 4 minimisers). Failure controls: two ill-formed
lines (`p(t) dot q(t) = 0`) are rejected; tampering with one fixture coordinate moves its
optimum to 19, so the positive control binds; disallowed B positions exist and are excluded.
The Pappus and Desargues constructions assert their collinearities and 3-uniformity
(3 points per line, 3 lines per point). `RESULT.json` records every per-size count and the
full-pair-set landscape.

Not checked: no lower bound is proved (cost >= v is verified instance by instance only); the
full pair sets carry upper bounds only; the Reye configuration and D4 line arrangements of the
same item are out of scope (no pinned point/covector encoding for them); the G1' lift witness
and the rational side (Lemma B) are not re-checked; no cold replay or supplier admission is
involved.

## Open next questions

1. **Reye and D4 line arrangements**, the remaining two families of item 4: fix a
   point/covector encoding for the Reye 12-point/16-line structure, then rerun this census
   unchanged. Blocked by: no predecessor pins such an encoding.
2. **A whole-set lower bound** for the full pair sets (fixed minors as in
   https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2176 or the [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) multi-copy
   certificate) against `v = 54`. Blocked by: that certificate machinery lives in [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111)/[PR 2162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2162)
   package code not vendored here.
3. **Tight atoms at sizes 7..12**: enlarge the fixed-seed samples or bias toward incidences as
   the [PR 2111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111) Hesse experiment did. Blocked by: exact enumeration stops at `f <= 20`.
